reviewed.body: Mercury turns back through {sign} in your {house} house, so plans, messages, and details in {house area} are more likely to snag. Back things up, re-confirm times, and revise what keeps resurfacing rather than forcing anything new. If it glitches anyway, adjust and move on.

{Planet} meets the Sun in {sign} — a brief clarity peak in your {house} house. Whatever this cycle has been teaching about {house area} shows up more clearly now. Set one clean intention; watch for the answer in ordinary places.

{Planet} enters {sign} and moves into your {house} house, turning attention to {house area}. Expect {sign-flavored behavior}. Put the energy toward {one concrete house action}, and don't {sign-flavored excess}.

Jupiter enters {sign} in your {house} house for about a year, expanding {house area}. This is permission to {sign growth}, but the same door can lead to {sign overgrowth}. Grow the part that's sustainable.
{Outer planet} begins a long passage through {sign} in your {house} house. The shift in {house area} won't be obvious day to day — it works over years. Notice the direction, not the single event.
Today's Moon works your {house} house, so {house area} is where the friction or pull shows up. Take one small action, don't chase instant results, and don't let the inner critic run the show.
{Planet}'s long transit sits in your {house} house, so {house area} changes gradually. Don't force the single moment; track the trend.

Uranus → sudden shake-ups and upgrades in {house area}; expect the unexpected, stay flexible. Neptune → {house area} gets dreamy and blurry; inspiring but easy to idealize — get real where it counts. Pluto → deep, irreversible transformation of power in {house area}; what's hollow gets composted. Chiron → an old sore spot in {house area} asks for patient tending, then becomes something you can teach. Nodes → your {houseA}/{houseB} axis is activated: grow toward {NN house}, release the over-reliance on {SN house}.

This week tears down early, asks you to sit with it midweek, and hands the energy back by the weekend. Notice what falls apart by Wednesday, process it Thursday and Friday, and choose where to spend the energy Saturday and Sunday.
